articles.title: Trump says he knows ‘nothing’ about World Liberty’s UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
articles.snippet: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun’s federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

articles.title: Strategy buys 1,036 Bitcoin as BTC holdings climb to 850,364
articles.snippet: Strategy bought $81.9 million in Bitcoin last week while spending $188.3 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, according to its latest SEC filing.

articles.title: NYSE Taps Avalanche to Settle Its Planned Tokenized Stock Platform
articles.snippet: Ava Labs said Avalanche will serve as the “core ledger technology” for the clearing firm behind the NYSE-affiliated venue, which aims to bring 24/7 trading, clearing and settlement of tokenized securities onchain.
